title: Ep 45 — Opus Five Five and GPT-Six Land in Copilot the Same Day, and the Formula Bot a Non-Coder Turned Into Six Figures
description: Anthropic's cheaper Claude Opus five point five and OpenAI's GPT-six Sol and Luna both landed on September the twenty-second and were live in GitHub Copilot within hours, while Lovable ended a quiet stretch with a new web-reading integration. Plus a deep dive on the plain-English spreadsheet-formula tool a solo, non-technical founder grew into a projected six-figure annual profit, and what today's actual Fundraising Regulator and DCMS good-causes deadline mean for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships.
